notes: Settings → Security: session lifetime and cookie policy, anti-bot, rate limiting, page caching and the SEO routes, all read live by the server.
Anti-bot: an invisible honeypot on public forms, plus optional Cloudflare Turnstile or Google reCAPTCHA v3. The secret key is stored where no visitor can read it, never in the options table.
Rate limiting on every /api route, counted per address and per account, with separate ceilings for authentication and for ordinary traffic.
Server-side page caching with ETags and stale-while-revalidate; never for signed-in visitors, and purged automatically when content or settings change.
/sitemap.xml is generated from published content, and /robots.txt is editable in the admin.
Sign an account out of every device from Settings → Security.
Backups no longer contain credential tables, so a backup file cannot leak a CAPTCHA secret or a chat bot token.
Engagement: Like, Save (with your own collections) and Follow buttons for posts, authors and categories, and view counts.
Settings → Engagement switches each feature off site-wide, and chooses where buttons appear automatically.
The visitors' dashboard has My saved collections and a Following feed that refreshes itself when a followed author publishes.
Dashboard → Analytics: views, likes, saves and follows per period, top content and most-followed authors.
New shortcodes: [rwp_like], [rwp_save], [rwp_follow], [rwp_views], [rwp_engagement], [rwp_popular_content], [rwp_saved_collections], [rwp_following_feed].
Views count once per browser per item every 30 minutes, never for the author, and store no IP address or visitor id.
Chatbot support: a product card and order tracking inside the chat widget, and in-chat add to cart (needs supabase/migrations/20261009_shop_chat.sql).
Shop → Backup: export orders, products, reports, customers, coupons, reviews, offers, questions, price alerts, bundles and settings to a ZIP (with optional spreadsheet copies), and import it back.
Import chooses per part: update & add, add missing only, replace, or add as copies (products and coupons), with a preview of every change before anything is written.
Product likes, saves (wishlists) and view counts.
Product Q&A: customers ask, the store answers under Shop → Questions.
Make an Offer: accept, decline or counter under Shop → Offers; an accepted offer becomes a single-use coupon.
Price-drop alerts, emailed from Shop → Price alerts.
Frequently Bought Together with an optional bundle discount, set under Shop → Bundles and applied at checkout.
New shortcodes [rwp_product_qa], [rwp_make_offer], [rwp_price_alert], [rwp_frequently_bought] and matching Page Builder widgets.
A floating chat launcher on every page, and an inline support box for Contact pages ([rwp_inline_chat], plus Page Builder widgets).
A Gemini-backed assistant that answers from the site's own pages. The key stays on the server.
A pre-chat form that captures the visitor's name, email and phone as a lead before the conversation starts.
File attachments, stored in their own Media Library folder so they stay out of All media.
Handover to a person: the admin inbox, a free Telegram notification, a free wa.me link, or a WhatsApp Business API push.
On a shop site: a product card for the page being viewed, in-chat add to cart, and order tracking by order number plus email.
Every message is logged, with the model that produced each assistant reply, under Chat → Inbox.
New Engagement Bar and Popular Content widgets.
